workflow: Claimed the pre-registered A-S045 mission through state.ps1 as worker-A-S045.
Read exact README S045, D-S045, atomic/portable contract, A/B rows and default SC-S045 packet rule before behavior design.
Wrote websocket.feature before fixtures, loadable API stub and behavioral assertions.
Captured 23 real assertion failures against that loadable stub, with raw provenance and non-discovered snapshots.
Recorded resource-free IaC N/A in manifest.json after RED and before implementation.
Implemented acknowledged resume, version decoding, sequence/state/budget checks, guarded controls and bounded retained history.
Preserved an initial browser inspection assertion failure, then corrected fieldset inspection without changing runtime behavior.
Captured actual successful DOM, keyboard, error, failure, unknown, history-limit, exact-reset and enforced-CSP checks using only the pinned published helper.
Passed 41 focused checks with browser capture disabled; the entire owned tree remained byte-for-byte unchanged by verification.
Passed syntax checks for all seven runtime/test scripts; final focused verification and integrity are recorded in the referenced output artifacts.

Initial publication preflight stopped before commit/tag/push on raw CRLF snapshot textual whitespace. Preserved diagnostic output, marked only raw snapshots binary, and retained every original snapshot byte.
Parent-owned publication review and acceptance remain separate from exercise prediction verdicts.

integrity.checks: Eight focused read-only integrity cases included in the 41-test run
integrity.rule: Canonical LF text; unchanged raw gzip and snapshot bytes; generated run logs and the hash document itself are explicitly excluded from self-reference.

browser.mechanism: Actual isolated headless file browser; openIsolatedLesson and awaited finally close

priorFailedInspection.reason: Playwright 1.56.1 fieldset isDisabled inspection returned false. Corrected to native fieldset.disabled plus actual disabled select/input checks; no runtime behavior change.

provenance.rawOutput: Per-run gzip files retain verbatim stdout/stderr with SHA-256 metadata.
provenance.readableNormalization: Trailing spaces/tabs only are removed from readable TAP copies.
provenance.snapshotRule: Original snapshot bytes are preserved with owned binary attributes (-text -diff -merge); snapshots are not automatically discovered as tests.

verifierResult.engineering: All 41 focused checks, actual isolated-browser capture and independent read-only browser rerun passed. Seven script syntax checks passed. Referenced raw logs and content hashes are the authority; the whole owned tree stayed unchanged by normal verification.
verifierResult.exercise: A prediction verifier compares expected versus synthetic impact; it never changes the impact.
verifierResult.negative: Predicting interrupted can PASS while user impact stays interrupted.
verifierResult.unknown: Absent cursor or post-reconnect observation remains unknown, never successful continuity.

userImpactResult.syntheticSafe: Resume after ACK3; visible sequences 1-6; ACK6; state60; gap80ms within original100ms budget.
userImpactResult.syntheticReplayProtected: Three acknowledged wire replays detected and suppressed; zero duplicate visible effects; state60.
userImpactResult.syntheticBlindReplay: Three duplicate effects; state90; interrupted even when prediction verifier passes.
userImpactResult.syntheticMissingSequence: Missing5 prevents ACK6; finalACK4; visible5,6 absent; interrupted.
userImpactResult.syntheticStateLoss: Replay can reach ACK6 while state is only30; interrupted.
userImpactResult.syntheticVersionMismatch: v1-only decoder rejects all three v2 frames; interrupted.
userImpactResult.syntheticPartialUnknown: Sequence/state proof stays unknown; a known original-budget breach or acknowledged-state loss still interrupts.

limits: All workload data, acknowledgements, state, versions, elapsed times and predictions are synthetic.
No live WebSocket, real reconnect, native Azure result, source-parent completion or five-nines claim.
No production Node.js24 or arbitrary browser/lifecycle-runner certification.
Only existing offline Playwright1.56.1 with installed signed Edge156 was checked.
Known shared-helper unattended shutdown limitations remain; no abandoned lifecycle prototype is used.
History is in-memory and erased by explicit Reset or page reload.
No real identity, authentication, tokens, keys, credentials, cloud resources, packages, framework or shared-file changes.
Engineering cases and repeated verification earn no additional Kano credit; parent alone accepts the one A-S045 unit.
